Concurrent-replay-under-contention test ('should replay deterministically while concurrent writes are happening') intermittently asserts an off-by-one event count (e.g. expected 46 to be 45). Non-deterministic: passes 7/7 in isolation and on most full-suite runs, but intermittently fails the maintained blocking lane (main CI run 26996823006). Not in the bootable-production surface; not a protected Phase D/P2B/P2C test. Quarantined to make the blocking lane deterministic; still runs in the visible non-blocking lane.

Same contention-driven flake class as phase-3-serialization-hardening: this suite drives concurrent writes/replay (6 Promise.all concurrent-write blocks across 'monotonic eventNumbers across concurrent updates', 'deterministic replay across concurrent operations', 'concurrent mutations on same aggregate', 'event loss under concurrent pressure'). Produces the same off-by-one event-count non-determinism under the CI runner's contention. After phase-3-serialization-hardening was quarantined, the maintained blocking lane still failed intermittently (CI run 27001605179) on this cluster. Authorized cluster quarantine: only the two maintained event-sourcing suites that exercise concurrent contended writes are excluded; all deterministic event-sourcing suites (authoritative-replay, event-replay-engine, event-sourcing-truth, hardening-proofs, idempotency-proofs, snapshot-engine, projection-engine, db-smoke) remain in the blocking lane. Not in the bootable-production surface; not a protected Phase D/P2B/P2C test. Still runs in the visible non-blocking lane.

Replay-determinism proof with a wall-clock PERFORMANCE assertion: 'should replay 1000 events with consistent performance' asserts expect(duration2).toBeLessThan(duration1 * 2) on two in-process Date.now() replay timings. This is machine-timing nondeterministic (GC/JIT/CI contention) and intermittently fails (e.g. 'expected 7 to be less than 4') -- CI run 27076172614 and reproduced locally -- while the deterministic assertions in the same test (replay1.hash === replay2.hash, eventCount === 1000) pass. Same nondeterministic replay class as phase-3-serialization-hardening and phase-3-concurrency-proofs. Not in the bootable-production surface; touches no production/launch user journey; not a protected Phase D/P2B/P2C test. Quarantined to keep the maintained blocking lane deterministic during launch week; still runs in the visible non-blocking lane.

Deterministic single-test conflict surfaced when CI first ran the DB-backed maintained suite past the (previously red) governance/lint gates on 2026-06-24 (CI run 28065415725: 1 failed / 10692 passed / 6 skipped). Case 'P2 fix — non-governance cases do NOT fire > 2 items each with only 1 weak LEGAL_TEXT term ... boundary guard' asserts .not.toBe(LEGAL_GOVERNANCE_RISK), but consulting-engine/diagnosis-engine.ts fin_isLegalGovernanceByText fires because the item 'RBI ... regulatory intervention increasingly probable' matches STRONG_LEGAL_TEXT (P3-G terms 'regulatory intervention' / 'rbi.*intervention'), making it substantive. This is a genuine semantic conflict between the P2 false-positive guard and the P3-G RBI-intervention detection -- a consulting-engine product judgment OUTSIDE Owner Mode scope, with regression risk to real RBI-takeover/licence-revocation cases either way. NOT authored by the Owner Mode Decision OS branch; the file's other 17 tests pass. Quarantined (owner-approved) to make the blocking lane green; still runs in the visible non-blocking lane. Resolve under the consulting-engine heuristic owner, not Owner Mode.

Three tests assert workflowContent.on.push.branches and workflowContent.on.pull_request.branches on .github/workflows/ci-cd-foundations.yml, but that file uses only workflow_dispatch (no push/pull_request triggers). TypeError: Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'branches') at lines 32 and 38. Last modified ebd66cde (predates A7.7 merge d5594f76); proven present on main before A7.7.

All 9 tests call vi.spyOn(db.recommendation, 'findMany') but db.recommendation lacks findMany in the Prisma mock; Error: The property 'findMany' is not defined on the object. Mock contract has drifted from the Prisma model definition. Last modified 1383008f (predates A7.7 merge d5594f76); proven present on main before A7.7.
